verdict.rationale: Netlify's own docs state that every PR gets a preview URL and that Deploy Previews let you review every change before it goes live. Independent community users confirm the GitHub integration renders a preview build of any PR. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation detailing Deploy Preview configuration and behavior (the evidence is marketing-level statements).

support.subject: As a developer, I can get an automatic preview URL for every pull request

citations.quote: Every PR gets a preview URL.
Review every change before it goes live with Deploy Previews
The real killer bit for me has been their GitHub integration where they render a preview build of any PRs.
